note: Header fields are read directly from the input file and control later allocation and scanline processing.
The parsed dimensions are used to allocate the destination image before any validation of zero-sized dimensions.
The implementation should ensure the multiplication cannot overflow before using the result to size RLE tables; that safety obligation is violated for large header values.
The overflowed row count is used as an allocation size, leading to an invalid allocation and downstream memory corruption or sanitizer failure.
